label:
Casein coating
(paper, leather)
step: mix with clay or pigment, coat
note: Paper coating was replaced by starch and SB latex; leather glazing is a niche that remains.

about.text: Dissolved casein used as the glue in a coating: with clay on art paper in the late 19th to mid 20th century, and with pigment on leather, which is then glazed under heat and pressure. It was the main leather binder by 1920.

facts.v: Late 19th to mid-20th c.; patent US4302367 describes the replacement
c. 1910 to now, niche; applied with pigment, glazed under heat and pressure
